aisec: Unit 42 documents campaigns where autonomous AI agents automated intrusions using ordinary tools yet left distinctive traces; the UK cyber agency says AI-driven attacks mostly exploit long-neglected basic weaknesses.

Research shows many LLM attack surfaces: quantization-conditioned backdoors, single-bit flips, jailbreak suffix sampling, criteria hijacking in recommenders, numeric leakage across linked prompts, and fingerprinting the LLM behind agents.

Defensive work includes attestation-based zero-trust for HPC agents, red-teaming a sovereign LLM's prompt confidentiality, testing whether LLMs will run advance-fee scams, and deepfakes of executives like Jensen Huang spreading widely.
ai: Nvidia's Jensen Huang dominates coverage: he reportedly apologized in an all-hands, thanked the White House, denied political pressure got him rehired, and still opposes formal succession planning.

Platforms and publishers push back on synthetic content: Tidal will ban AI-generated music from December 9th, The New York Times warns photographers about Photoshop AI features, and viewers suspect AI in a Fincher film.

Agents move into commerce while limits show: Meta's Muse arrives in Instagram DMs and Walmart Black Friday deals, yet a benchmark finds top agents struggle with everyday tasks; Anthropic shares fall below IPO price.
cyber: Breaches pile up: Rackspace is closing its Spot platform, Radware exposed customer cloud keys, Turnitin and the European Commission's EU Academy reported intrusions, an unclassified CIA system was breached, and Colorado's myColorado app lost about 150,000 user

Extortion and espionage activity: the new Inception vishing group is linked to ShinyHunters-associated actors, ShinyHunters claims a return, Iran-aligned Volant Manticore uses an IPFS-based backdoor, and Webworm customizes SoftEther VPN.

VMware patched critical ESX and vCenter flaws including a 9.8-rated authentication bypass; researchers flagged border-control visa system flaws and weak satellite ground infrastructure, while lawmakers press ID verification firms to improve security.
